Four tiers each of Energy, Thermal, Item, Fluid, and Pressurized Conduits are available. Energy Conduits share FE across connected networks. Thermal Conduits move HU with a per-segment rate. Item Conduits move items between configured output and input faces, up to 8 / 16 / 32 / 64 items per operation. Fluid Conduits move one liquid at a time at 200 / 800 / 3,200 / 12,800 mB/t; Pressurized Conduits move one of the supported Arcforge gases at 400 / 1,600 / 6,400 / 25,600 mB/t. Mixed-tier networks use the slowest tier. Item and fluid conduits move directly between connected blocks; they do not buffer items or fluids, animate packets, or support filters.
# The Wrench
Craft it from three iron ingots and a copper ingot. Right-click Energy, Thermal, or Item Conduit faces to cycle Auto, Input, Output, and Disabled. Auto permits either direction, Input receives, Output sends, and Disabled disconnects. Fluid and Pressurized Conduits detect compatible sided tanks automatically. The Wrench also sets supported Solar heat-output faces, configures adjacent-transfer output faces on the Combustion and Thermoelectric Plants, and rotates supported single-block machines. Other Wrench modes, sneaking reverse-cycle, dismantling, and conduit joint controls are not implemented.

# Solar heat output
A Solar Thermal Array starts with all output faces disabled. Right-click a formed tower part with the Wrench on the face that should send heat. This saves the setting on the controller and lets supported adjacent machines or Thermal Conduits receive heat. Enabled faces show a steel collar and heat-port plate on formed tower parts. Other multiblock port types and port screens are not implemented.
